question: Which one of the following is the correct chronological sequence of the major rock systems of India from oldest to youngest?
questionHindi: भारत की प्रमुख शैल प्रणालियों का प्राचीनतम से नवीनतम की ओर सही कालानुक्रमिक क्रम कौन सा है?
options: Archaean -> Dharwar -> Cuddapah -> Vindhyan -> Gondwana
Dharwar -> Archaean -> Vindhyan -> Cuddapah -> Gondwana
Cuddapah -> Dharwar -> Archaean -> Gondwana -> Vindhyan
Archaean -> Cuddapah -> Dharwar -> Gondwana -> Vindhyan
hints: Hint 1: Archaean rocks represent the basement complex formed during the cooling of Earth's crust.
Hint 2: Dharwar is the oldest sedimentary rock system formed from erosion of Archaean rocks.
Hint 3: Gondwana was formed much later in the Carboniferous-Permian era.
trapAlert: Do not confuse Cuddapah and Vindhyan sequence; Cuddapah preceded Vindhyan.
explanation: The geological chronological sequence is: Archaean (oldest) -> Dharwar -> Cuddapah -> Vindhyan -> Gondwana -> Deccan Trap -> Tertiary -> Quaternary (youngest).
explanationHindi: सही कालानुक्रम है: आर्कियन (सबसे प्राचीन) -> धारवाड़ -> कुडप्पा -> विंध्यन -> गोंडवाना -> दक्कन ट्रैप -> टर्शियरी -> क्वाटरनरी।

question: In the Northern Plains of India, the coarse gravel and pebble belt lying parallel to the Shiwalik foothills where streams disappear underground is known as:
questionHindi: भारत के उत्तरी मैदानों में शिवालिक की तलहटी के समानांतर स्थित कंकड़-पत्थरों की वह पट्टी जहां नदियां भूमिगत हो जाती हैं, कहलाती है:
options: Terai
Bhabar
Bhangar
Khadar
hints: Hint 1: This belt is 8 to 16 km wide along the Shiwalik piedmont.
Hint 2: Porosity is extremely high due to heavy gravel deposition.
Hint 3: The marshy zone directly south of it is called Terai.
trapAlert: Do not confuse Bhabar (where rivers disappear) with Terai (where rivers re-emerge).
explanation: Bhabar is an 8–16 km wide belt of coarse gravel deposited by rivers exiting the Himalayas. Due to high porosity, streams sink underground here and re-emerge in the swampy Terai belt to the south.
explanationHindi: भाबर शिवालिक के समानांतर 8 से 16 किमी चौड़ी कंकड़-पत्थरों की पट्टी है। अत्यधिक सरंध्रता के कारण नदियां इसमें लुप्त हो जाती हैं और दक्षिण में तराई में पुनः प्रकट होती हैं।

question: Which of the following passes connects Srinagar with Leh and Kargil, carrying National Highway 1 across the Great Himalayas?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दर्रा श्रीनगर को लेह और कारगिल से जोड़ता है और महान हिमालय में NH-1 इसी से होकर गुजरता है?
options: Banihal Pass
Zoji La
Shipki La
Nathu La
hints: Hint 1: It is situated at an elevation of ~3,528 m in Ladakh/J&K.
Hint 2: A 14.15 km all-weather bi-directional tunnel is currently under construction here.
Hint 3: Banihal connects Jammu to Srinagar, while this pass connects Srinagar to Leh.
trapAlert: Banihal connects Jammu with Srinagar; Zoji La connects Srinagar with Ladakh.
explanation: Zoji La sits at ~3,528 m on the Great Himalayas, connecting Srinagar Valley with Dras, Kargil, and Leh on NH-1.
explanationHindi: ज़ोजी ला (~3,528 मीटर) श्रीनगर को द्रास, कारगिल और लेह से जोड़ता है।

question: Anamudi, the highest peak in Peninsular India and the Western Ghats (2,695 m), is located in which hill range?
questionHindi: प्रायद्वीपीय भारत और पश्चिमी घाट की सबसे ऊंची चोटी अनामुडी (2,695 मीटर) किस पहाड़ी श्रृंखला में स्थित है?
options: Nilgiri Hills
Anamalai Hills
Cardamom Hills
Palani Hills
hints: Hint 1: It is located in the Idukki district of Kerala.
Hint 2: Doddabetta is the highest peak in the Nilgiris (2,637 m), not Anamudi.
Hint 3: The name literally translates to 'Elephant Head' in Malayalam/Tamil.
trapAlert: Doddabetta is in Nilgiris; Anamudi is in Anamalai Hills.
explanation: Anamudi (2,695 m) is in the Anamalai Hills of Kerala inside Eravikulam National Park. It is the highest peak in South India.
explanationHindi: अनामुडी (2,695 मीटर) केरल की अनामलाई पहाड़ियों में स्थित दक्षिण भारत की सर्वोच्च चोटी है।

question: Which of the following is the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन पूर्वी घाट की सबसे ऊंची चोटी है?
options: Mahendragiri (Odisha)
Jindhagada / Arma Konda (Andhra Pradesh)
Malayagiri (Odisha)
Doddabetta (Tamil Nadu)
hints: Hint 1: It is located in the Araku Valley of Visakhapatnam district.
Hint 2: Its elevation is 1,690 m, surpassing Mahendragiri (1,501 m).
Hint 3: Older textbooks often cited Mahendragiri, but modern surveys confirm this peak.
trapAlert: Mahendragiri was traditionally cited, but Jindhagada (1,690 m) is the undisputed highest peak.
explanation: Arma Konda / Jindhagada Peak (1,690 m) in Andhra Pradesh is the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats, followed by Deomali (1,672 m) and Mahendragiri (1,501 m).
explanationHindi: पूर्वी घाट की सबसे ऊंची चोटी जिंधागड़ा / अरमा कोंडा (1,690 मीटर, आंध्र प्रदेश) है।

question: The Ten Degree Channel (10° Channel) separates which of the following pairs of island territories?
questionHindi: दस डिग्री चैनल (10° Channel) निम्नलिखित में से किस द्वीप समूह युग्म को अलग करता है?
options: South Andaman and Little Andaman
Little Andaman and Car Nicobar
Great Nicobar and Sumatra
Minicoy and Lakshadweep
hints: Hint 1: It separates the Andaman archipelago from the Nicobar archipelago.
Hint 2: Duncan Passage separates South Andaman from Little Andaman.
Hint 3: The 10°N latitude passes directly between Little Andaman and Car Nicobar.
trapAlert: Duncan passage is between South & Little Andaman; 10° Channel is between Little Andaman & Car Nicobar.
explanation: The 10° Channel is ~150 km wide along the 10°N parallel, separating Little Andaman (Andaman group) from Car Nicobar (Nicobar group).
explanationHindi: 10 डिग्री चैनल लिटिल अंडमान को कार निकोबार से अलग करता है।

question: The Indian Standard Meridian (82°30'E) does NOT pass through which of the following states?
questionHindi: भारतीय मानक समय रेखा (82°30' पूर्व) निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य से होकर नहीं गुजरती है?
options: Uttar Pradesh
Madhya Pradesh
Chhattisgarh
Telangana
hints: Hint 1: 82°30'E passes through five Indian states from North to South.
Hint 2: It passes near Mirzapur in UP, then MP, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh.
Hint 3: It lies east of Telangana.
trapAlert: Telangana does not touch 82°30'E; it passes through Andhra Pradesh instead.
explanation: The 82°30'E meridian passes through 5 states: Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh. It does not pass through Telangana.
explanationHindi: 82°30' पूर्व देशांतर रेखा 5 राज्यों (यूपी, एमपी, छत्तीसगढ़, ओडिशा, आंध्र प्रदेश) से गुजरती है; यह तेलंगाना से नहीं गुजरती।

question: Consider the following Himalayan longitudinal valleys (Duns). Dehradun, Kotli Dun, and Patli Dun are located between which two ranges?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित हिमालयी अनुदैर्ध्य घाटियों (दूं) पर विचार करें। देहरादून, कोटली दून और पाटली दून किन दो पर्वत श्रेणियों के बीच स्थित हैं?
options: Greater Himalayas and Lesser Himalayas
Lesser Himalayas and Shiwalik Range
Trans-Himalayas and Greater Himalayas
Shiwalik Range and Indo-Gangetic Plains
optionsHindi: शिवालिक श्रेणी और भारत-गंगा का मैदान
hints: Hint 1: They are flat-bottomed structural valleys formed during the late stage of folding.
Hint 2: Dehradun is the largest of these valleys (~35 km long).
Hint 3: They sit between Himachal (Lesser Himalaya) and the outermost Shiwaliks.
trapAlert: Do not place Duns between Great and Lesser Himalayas (which host Kashmir Valley).
explanation: Duns are flat-bottomed longitudinal valleys situated between the Lesser Himalayas (Himachal) and the Outer Himalayas (Shiwalik Range).
explanationHindi: दून (जैसे देहरादून) लघु हिमालय और शिवालिक श्रेणी के बीच स्थित अनुदैर्ध्य घाटियाँ हैं।

question: Through which of the following mountain gaps in the Western Ghats does the primary rail and road freight corridor between Mumbai and Pune pass?
questionHindi: पश्चिमी घाट के निम्नलिखित में से किस पर्वतीय दर्रे से होकर मुंबई और पुणे के बीच प्राथमिक रेल और सड़क माल ढुलाई गलियारा गुजरता है?
options: Thal Ghat
Bhor Ghat
Palghat Gap
Shencottah Gap
hints: Hint 1: It is also known as Khandala Ghat.
Hint 2: Thal Ghat connects Mumbai with Nashik/Agra.
Hint 3: Bhor Ghat carries the Mumbai-Pune Expressway (NH-48).
trapAlert: Thal Ghat = Mumbai to Nashik; Bhor Ghat = Mumbai to Pune.
explanation: Bhor Ghat connects the Konkan coast (Mumbai/Navi Mumbai) with Pune on the Deccan Plateau across the Western Ghats escarpment.
explanationHindi: भोर घाट (खंडाला घाट) मुंबई को पुणे और दक्षिणी दक्कन से जोड़ता है।

question: In the Thar Desert, crescent-shaped shifting sand dunes with horns pointing in the direction of the wind are known as:
questionHindi: थार मरुस्थल में हवा की दिशा में नुकीले सिरों वाले अर्धचंद्राकार बालू के टीलों को क्या कहा जाता है?
options: Barchans
Seifs
Playa lakes
Dhrians
hints: Hint 1: They are the most characteristic aeolian depositional landform in arid zones.
Hint 2: Seif is a longitudinal dune.
Hint 3: Barchans form transverse to the wind direction with a gentle windward slope.
trapAlert: Seifs are longitudinal; Barchans are crescent-shaped.
explanation: Barchans are crescent-shaped dunes with convex windward slopes and concave slip faces pointing downwind, common in western Rajasthan.
explanationHindi: बरखान हवा की दिशा में मुड़े हुए सींगों वाले अर्धचंद्राकार रेत के टीले होते हैं।

question: Consider statement 26: The Malda Gap (Garo-Rajmahal Gap) separates which two morphological units of India?

options: The Peninsular Plateau and the Meghalaya (Shillong) Plateau

The Northern Plains and the Thar Desert
hints: Hint 1: Ganga and Brahmaputra rivers flow through this down-faulted gap.

explanation: The Malda Gap was formed by down-faulting between the Rajmahal hills and Garo hills, later filled with alluvium by Ganga-Brahmaputra.
explanationHindi: मालदा गैप गंगा-ब्रह्मपुत्र द्वारा भरे गए गर्त के रूप में प्रायद्वीपीय पठार को मेघालय पठार से अलग करता है।

question: Consider the following tributaries of the Indus river: 1. Chenab, 2. Jhelum, 3. Ravi, 4. Sutlej. Which one of the following joins directly into the Indus without meeting another intermediate river?
questionHindi: सिंधु नदी की निम्नलिखित सहायक नदियों पर विचार करें: 1. चिनाब, 2. झेलम, 3. रावी, 4. सतलुज। इनमें से कौन सी सीधे सिंधु नदी में मिलती है बिना किसी अन्य मध्यवर्ती नदी में मिले?
options: Chenab
Jhelum
Ravi
Sutlej
hints: Hint 1: Jhelum joins Chenab near Trimmu.
Hint 2: Ravi joins Chenab near Sarai Sidhu.
Hint 3: Sutlej joins Chenab at Uch/Mithankot as the Panjnad, and the combined Panjnad (predominantly Chenab) empties into the Indus.
trapAlert: Chenab gathers the waters of Jhelum, Ravi, and Sutlej before discharging into the Indus.
explanation: Jhelum joins Chenab; Ravi joins Chenab; Sutlej receives Beas and then joins Chenab. The combined five rivers flow as Panjnad (headed by Chenab) directly into the Indus near Mithankot.
explanationHindi: झेलम, रावी और सतलुज सभी अंततः चिनाब में मिलती हैं और पंचनद के रूप में चिनाब सीधे सिंधु नदी में विलीन होती है।

question: At which of the following confluences (Prayags) do the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi rivers meet to form the Ganga?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित में से किस संगम (प्रयाग) पर अलकनंदा और भागीरथी नदियाँ मिलकर गंगा बनाती हैं?
options: Vishnuprayag
Karnaprayag
Rudraprayag
Devprayag
hints: Hint 1: It is the lowest and most sacred of the Panch Prayags.
Hint 2: Rudraprayag is Alaknanda + Mandakini.
Hint 3: Devprayag is the confluence of Alaknanda and Bhagirathi.
trapAlert: Rudraprayag = Alaknanda + Mandakini; Devprayag = Alaknanda + Bhagirathi.
explanation: Devprayag is the sacred confluence in Garhwal Uttarakhand where Bhagirathi and Alaknanda join, from which point onwards the river is officially called the Ganga.
explanationHindi: देवप्रयाग में भागीरथी और अलकनंदा का संगम होता है, जिसके बाद इसे आधिकारिक तौर पर गंगा कहा जाता है।

question: Which of the following is a LEFT-BANK tributary of the Ganga?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन गंगा की बाईं तट (Left-Bank) की सहायक नदी है?
options: Yamuna
Son
Gandak
Tons
hints: Hint 1: Look in the direction the river flows (eastward/southeastward).
Hint 2: Rivers entering from the Himalayan north are left-bank tributaries.
Hint 3: Yamuna and Son enter from the southern/right-bank side.
trapAlert: Yamuna, Son, and Punpun are right-bank; Ramganga, Gomti, Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi are left-bank.
explanation: Gandak originates in the Nepal Himalayas and joins the Ganga on its left bank near Patna (Hajipur).
explanationHindi: गंडक नेपाल हिमालय से निकलकर हाजीपुर (पटना) के पास गंगा के बाएं तट पर मिलती है।

question: Why do the Narmada and Tapi rivers flow westward into the Arabian Sea, unlike most other major Peninsular rivers?
questionHindi: नर्मदा और तापी नदियां अधिकांश अन्य प्रमुख प्रायद्वीपीय नदियों के विपरीत पश्चिम की ओर अरब सागर में क्यों बहती हैं?
options: They flow through structural rift valleys (graben)
They have higher water discharge than eastern rivers
The Himalayas tilt the northern plateau southward
They are glacier-fed perennial streams
optionsHindi: वे भ्रंश घाटियों (Rift Valleys) से होकर बहती हैं
उनमें पूर्वी नदियों की तुलना में अधिक जल निर्वहन होता है
हिमालय उत्तरी पठार को दक्षिण की ओर झुकाता है
hints: Hint 1: The general slope of the Peninsular plateau is from West to East.
Hint 2: Faulting occurred during the breakup of Gondwana and Himalayan collision.
Hint 3: Narmada flows between the Vindhyas and Satpuras in a tectonic trough.
trapAlert: Rift valleys dictate their course against the regional eastward plateau slope.
explanation: Narmada and Tapi flow through tectonic rift valleys (graben) formed by faulting between the Vindhya and Satpura ranges, sloping westwards into the Gulf of Khambhat.
explanationHindi: नर्मदा और तापी विंध्य और सतपुड़ा के बीच भ्रंश घाटी (Rift Valley) से होकर बहती हैं।

question: Which of the following is the world's largest inhabited freshwater river island, situated on the Brahmaputra River in Assam?
questionHindi: असम में ब्रह्मपुत्र नदी पर स्थित विश्व का सबसे बड़ा आबाद मीठे पानी का नदी द्वीप कौन सा है?
options: Umananda Island
Majuli Island
Diu Island
Munroe Island
hints: Hint 1: It was declared a district of Assam in 2016.
Hint 2: Formed by the bifurcation of Brahmaputra and Kherkutia Xuti joined by Subansiri.
Hint 3: Cultural center of Neo-Vaishnavite Satras established by Srimanta Sankardev.
trapAlert: Umananda is the smallest inhabited river island in the world; Majuli is the largest.
explanation: Majuli Island on the Brahmaputra in Assam is the world's largest freshwater river island, renowned for its Vaishnavite Satras.
explanationHindi: माजुली असम में ब्रह्मपुत्र नदी पर स्थित विश्व का सबसे बड़ा आबाद नदी द्वीप है।
